claim: VCs spend an average of 3 minutes 44 seconds reading a first-time pitch deck, with the critical first three slides determining whether they continue reading.
value_for_lead_magnet: Establishes the brutal time constraint that justifies one-pager discipline; shows that investors filter in the first 90 seconds.
verbatim_quote: The problem statement should be grasped in 20 seconds, and the solution in 30 seconds.

claim: The team slide receives the most investor attention (1 minute 2 seconds) in pitch decks, significantly more than product (21 seconds), indicating founders are more important than initial product market fit.
value_for_lead_magnet: Justifies why one-pagers must lead with founder credibility and market fit; explains what investors actually weight.
verbatim_quote: Team — 1 minute 2 seconds [most-viewed slide by duration]

claim: Warm introductions achieve 40-50% meeting conversion rates while cold decks achieve 3-5%, a 10-15x difference in response rates.
value_for_lead_magnet: Frames the one-pager as a tool to convert cold→warm relationships; shows one-pagers are the bridge document for cold outreach sequencing.
verbatim_quote: Warm decks: 4+ minutes average reading time, 40-50% meeting conversion. Cold decks: 2.5 minutes average reading time, 3-5% conversion rate.

claim: If revenue model is not visible in the first eight lines of a one-pager, 71% of readers never see it; if key metrics are buried, they eliminate themselves from consideration.
value_for_lead_magnet: Provides hard data on information architecture and visual hierarchy; shows the cost of poor structural choices in one-pagers.
verbatim_quote: If your revenue model isn't visible in the first eight lines, 71% of readers never see it.

claim: One-pagers reduce cognitive load by approximately 47% compared to full pitch decks while maintaining narrative control, making them strategically superior for cold outreach.
value_for_lead_magnet: Quantifies the one-pager advantage in lead magnets; shows one-pagers as a tested friction-reduction tool.
verbatim_quote: By contrast, a one-pager reduces decision friction by approximately 47% while maintaining narrative control.

claim: Companies leading with traction metrics in one-pager summaries close funding rounds 6.4 weeks faster than those leading with vision statements.
value_for_lead_magnet: Demonstrates one-pager content sequencing impact on deal speed; shows measurable outcome from structure choices.
verbatim_quote: Companies that lead with traction metrics in their summaries close rounds 6.4 weeks faster than those that lead with vision statements.

claim: Ideal one-pager length is 400-500 words with white space; exceeding one page, lacking team information, or missing funding ask status are immediate disqualifiers.
value_for_lead_magnet: Sets concrete technical specifications for one-pager format; identifies the three most common failure modes.
verbatim_quote: Ideally 400-500 words with white space... having too many buzzwords, exceeding one page, lacking important information such as team or fundraising status, or missing a clear solution can lose investor interest.

claim: VCs process pitch documents as self-contained assets that may be shared with colleagues independently; one-pagers must be designed for standalone comprehension without presenter explanation.
value_for_lead_magnet: Explains why visual clarity and completeness matter in one-pagers; shows they function as proxy for founder communication ability.
verbatim_quote: Design your deck for rapid comprehension without verbal explanation, since investors often share decks with colleagues independently and may evaluate them without you present.

claim: Airbnb began as a simple WordPress one-pager in 2008 before scaling into a unicorn; demonstrates the one-pager as a proven early-stage VC communication standard.
value_for_lead_magnet: Provides credible, recognizable example of one-pager as launch vehicle for billion-dollar company; anchors one-pagers in VC folklore.
verbatim_quote: Airbnb was just a simple one-pager built on WordPress when it started more than ten years ago.
